name: Elm Cross-Gable
source: Original architecture recipe rebuilt with the native game-editor brush implementation
adaptations: Half-metre interior partitions snap to the one-metre game grid without scaling the building.
Roofs use supported flat/sloped two-metre editor modules and slab infill; complex sculpted roof profiles are simplified.
Roof hatches use native ladders. Closed doors retain native opening behavior.
Towers/turrets are rebuilt as supported grid rooms with stair access; curved outlines become stepped native walls.
Dormers, domes, cupolas, chimneys, balusters and the mill wheel remain art references rather than unsupported native objects.
The native editor palette supplies materials; the separate sculpt atlas is not substituted into game collision/rendering identifiers.
